name: notes-app
description: A simple notes application with Node.js backend and React frontend

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p backend/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
